name: id
description: The UUID identifying the Publisher edition record in the PostgreSQL database.

name: panopticon_id
description: The legacy Panopticon identifier that groups Publisher editions belonging to the same underlying GOV.UK content.

name: version_number
description: The sequential version number of the edition within the same underlying Publisher content.

name: sibling_in_progress
description: The version number of another edition of the same underlying Publisher content that was recorded as being in progress. The value is stored on a published or archived edition and can sometimes remain after the sibling stops being in progress or disappears from the table.

name: title
description: The title recorded for the Publisher edition.

name: in_beta
description: Indicates whether the edition is marked as beta in Publisher.

name: publish_at
description: The date and time at which the edition is scheduled to be published.

name: overview
description: The summary or overview text recorded for the edition.

name: slug
description: The slug recorded for the content in Publisher, used as the human-readable part of its GOV.UK path.

name: rejected_count
description: The number of times the edition has been rejected or returned for amendments during the Publisher editorial workflow. A value greater than zero can remain after the edition progresses to a later workflow state.

name: asignee
description: The name of the Publisher user who was assigned to the edition.

name: reviewer
description: Legacy or unused reviewer field. No populated values were found in the table.

name: creator
description: The name of the Publisher user who created the edition.

name: publisher
description: The name of the Publisher user who published the edition, where recorded.

name: archiver
description: The name of the Publisher user who archived the edition, where recorded.

name: major_change
description: Indicates whether the edition is marked as a major change.

name: change_note
description: The note describing the change made in this edition, where provided. A major_change should always be accompanied by a change_note.

name: state
description: The editorial workflow state of the Publisher edition. Observed values are draft, fact_check, in_review, amends_needed, ready, scheduled_for_publishing, published and archived.

name: review_requested_at
description: The date and time when review or fact checking was requested for the edition, where recorded. The value can remain populated after the edition has progressed to a later workflow state.

name: auth_bypass_id
description: A unique identifier for the edition that can be used to allow access to non-public content without authentication.

name: owning_org_content_ids
description: The content IDs of government organisations recorded as owning the edition’s content, stored as a string representation of an array. An empty array ({}) indicates that no owning organisation is recorded.

name: mongo_id
description: The identifier of the corresponding edition record in Publisher’s former MongoDB database, retained to correlate migrated PostgreSQL editions with their original records.

name: created_at
description: The date and time when the Publisher edition record was created.

name: updated_at
description: The date and time when the Publisher edition record was last updated.

name: editionable_type
description: The type of content-specific Publisher record associated with the edition, such as GuideEdition, AnswerEdition or TransactionEdition.

name: editionable_id
description: The identifier of the content-specific record associated with the edition. The value is unique within an editionable_type and must be used together with editionable_type to identify the record.

name: assigned_to_id
description: The identifier of the Publisher user who was assigned to the edition.
